Buffalo plaid Christmas stamps included:

· 2 buffalo plaid seamless pattern brush (small and big) and 9 Christmas symbols for Christmas ornaments silhouette decor in 1 brushset for Procreate (arabesque stamp, gingerbread stamp, bell stamp, gif box stamp, star stamp, Christmas tree stamp, Christmas car silhouette stamp, reindeer stamp)

Perfect for Christmas ornaments decor, text decor, wrapping paper and background, collage photo decorations, greeting cards

Only for iPad Procreate.

You will receive: 1 brushset file with 11 brushes (NOTE: for Procreate version 4.0 or earlier brushset is not available), and 1 swatches. If you need brush each in brush. file, please feel free to mail me to prepare this files.

How Installing Procreate Brushes (.brush and brushset)
Use this option if you have an older iPad or Procreate version 4.0 or earlier. Here’s how:
1. Download folder .brush file to your folder on your iPad
2. Open the folder and choose .brush files
3. Tap and hold with your finger or apple pencil
4. Choose “Share” from the menu
5. If the option “Open in Procreate” is missing, click on “More”
6. Scroll and find the option “Open in Procreate” and click on it
7. Open your project in Procreate and click on brush icon at the top right corner

Or
1. Open Procreate, click new collection – brush – import
2. Find folder with download brush, choose it, added in Procreate.
